[EN] There are relics throughout the basin that exhibit astonishing properties. Our research is geared towards identifying the source of those powers.

Are they inherent to the artifacts or are they merely vessels for something else?
[ES] Hay reliquias por toda la cuenca que muestran propiedades asombrosas. Nuestra investigación está orientada a identificar la fuente de esos poderes.

¿Son inherentes a los artefactos o son meramente recipientes para algo más?
